question: Should this PR's label-only status clarification be accepted as the fix for the heartbeat cadence report, or should the fix align status and scheduler cadence behavior instead?
rationale: The issue allows either explaining that status is showing config or aligning the cadence, and the PR chooses the smaller human-facing wording change while accepting a row-label compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Accept Narrow Clarification After Cleanup
options.body: Keep the label/docs/test approach, but require a rebase, removal of the changelog edit, and real CLI proof before merge.

options.title: Require Cadence Alignment
options.body: Ask for a broader fix that makes the status cadence match actual scheduler delivery rather than only clarifying the source of the displayed value.

options.title: Close This PR And Keep The Issue
options.body: Close this conflicted branch and leave https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78904 open for a maintainer-owned replacement direction.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Clarification After Cleanup
recommendation.body: Keep the label/docs/test approach, but require a rebase, removal of the changelog edit, and real CLI proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal is recent ownership of the status overview and status presentation surface touched by the PR.
